title: Chicken fajitas with peppers, salsa and yoghurt
steps: Cut the chicken into strips and mix with paprika, cumin, garlic, salt and half the lime juice.
Cut the peppers and onion into strips.
Finely dice the tomatoes and mix with coriander, salt and the remaining lime juice for a salsa.
Stir-fry the chicken in the oil for 5 minutes over high heat, add the vegetables and fry for 4 more minutes.
Warm the tortillas and fill with the chicken, vegetables, salsa and yoghurt.
